cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Approve the Cover Story
cards.instruction: Get someone to endorse an explanation that protects the plan, reputation, or people involved.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's handle this professionally. Will you back 'collecting chairs' when the caretaker asks why we opened the props cupboard? We need him to lend us the hall again.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I can explain the standard again. Slowly. Checking for folding stools, then. Can you back that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Only if you admit you borrowed his key.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes. Borrowed his key to check for extra seating. Will you sign the hall request with me?
